description: November 3 birthday meaning: Scorpio decan 2, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a November 3 birthday falls in Scorpio, in the second decan, with Pluto as the sign's ruler and Neptune as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Scorpio is fixed and water.

sections.heading: The November 3 birthday in astrology
paragraphs: Neptune, ruler of Pisces, becomes the sub-ruler as Scorpio's second decan opens around November 3. Imagination and empathy soften the sign's intensity. The birthday number 3 adds creativity and expressive flair, so the blend often suggests an artist of moods: someone who turns strong feelings into music, writing or images that other people find unexpectedly moving.

Astronomically, November 3 puts the Sun near 10° Scorpio in most years, inside the second ten-degree slice of the sign, which tradition links with Neptune. From 10 to 19 degrees of Scorpio, the sub-ruler is Neptune, modern ruler of Pisces. Early-to-mid November birthdays tend to soften the sign's intensity with intuition, imagination and empathy. These Scorpios are often seen as perceptive in an almost uncanny way, reading undercurrents in a room and drawn to art, healing work or spiritual questions. Neptune can blur edges, so feelings may be absorbed from others or idealised beyond recognition. The combination is powerful when grounded: deep emotional insight paired with compassion, used to help people face what they would rather not see alone.

sections.heading: Birthday number and Life Path for November 3
paragraphs: Born on the 3rd, you carry a birthday number of 3 in its simplest form. As a supporting number, the day of birth is read as a gift that shows in everyday style rather than in the larger direction of a life. The single-digit 3 is traditionally associated with expression: talking, writing, making things, finding the joke in a heavy afternoon. Its energy is light and spontaneous, often called youthful whatever the person's age. Numerologists tend to suggest that 3s benefit from finishing what they begin, because their ideas are worth more completed than merely sketched in a notebook.

Add the birth year and the picture shifts again: a November 3 birthday gives Life Path 6 for 1990, 7 for 2000, 8 for 2010 and 9 for 2020. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 22. Read the birthday number as a secondary note beside that main theme.

sections.heading: Season, Chinese zodiac and famous November 3 birthdays
paragraphs: A November birthday falls in late autumn for the northern hemisphere, a season of bare branches and early dusk, and in late spring for the southern, when the days lengthen fast. Scorpio holds most of the month, with Sagittarius arriving around November 22. In numerology November is month 11, a master number that is traditionally kept unreduced and linked with intuition and inspiration. November 3 is the 307th day of the year (308th in a leap year). Counting forward, the next sign change, into Sagittarius, is usually complete within 20 days, by November 23.

By November 3 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year. Among the best-known people with a November 3 birthday are Kendall Jenner (1995), Amartya Sen (1933) and André Malraux (1901).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is November 3?
faq.answer: November 3 is Scorpio in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the second decan of Scorpio, which tradition links with Neptune.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on November 3?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On November 3 the Life Path is 3 in 1960, 22 in 1970, 5 in 1980, 6 in 1990, 7 in 2000, 8 in 2010 and 9 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 3rd.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on November 3?
faq.answer: For the Chinese zodiac, Lunar New Year has always passed by November 3, so the animal is simply the one for the birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on November 3?
faq.answer: Well-known people born on November 3 include Kendall Jenner (1995), Amartya Sen (1933) and André Malraux (1901). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
